description: Job title: Area Business Manager, Hematology/Oncology- Brooklyn, NYLocation: Remote, USAbout the Job: The Oncology Area Business Manager (ABM) is accountable for achieving annual sales objectives for a Brooklyn territory through the development, maintenance and enhancement of key customer relationships. Responsibilities include development and implementation of effective territory planning and leveraging Sanofi resources successfully. Utilization of effective selling techniques and marketing strategies to create and expand product understanding and appropriate patient identification are also a must. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity strictly following all Sanofi US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.   We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.  Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi:  We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main Responsibilities:  Develop and utilize a business plan aligned with marketing strategies through territory analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and customer insights (updated quarterly). Implement business plans through leveraging all appropriate resources, both human and physical, with Hematologists and Oncologists and other appropriate key customers. Develop as product, disease state and marketplace expert. Effectively communicate and position product information to customers in order to successfully promote the appropriate use of the Sanofi oncology portfolio within territory. Work closely with all field partners as necessary to ensure strategy pull through from Key IDNs/System, Reimbursement, Key Accounts, other ABMs and Medical (as appropriate). Complete call reporting, business plan updates and expense reports, and operate within all Pharma compliance guidelines. Effective account targeting and time management. Attend training sessions as required and conventions and symposia, as necessary. Complete all fleet safety training and maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.   About You Basic Qualifications:  BA/BS degree from an accredited school required. CX Analytics and Marketing Automation Manager

Job Overview

The CX Analytics & Marketing Automation role owns and advances the CX analytics capability for Japan to enable more data-driven decision making across channel engagement.

This is a senior individual contributor role that reports into the Customer Experience group within the Commercial Excellence Division. This role is accountable for translating customer engagement data into actionable insights, performance optimization opportunities, and clear recommendations that improve omnichannel execution and customer experience. The role owns the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of OC dashboards and measurement frameworks, ensuring they are embedded into business rhythms and used by Omnichannel, BU, and cross-functional teams to make better channel investment, activation, and optimization decisions. In addition, the role has end-to-end ownership of Customer Data Platform (CDP) operations and capability development, including data readiness, segmentation, activation enablement, roadmap input, and continuous advancement of CDP use cases to accelerate marketing automation, personalization, and compliant activation.

Responsibilities:

CX Performance Analytics, Monitoring & Insights

Own and lead the CX analytics capability for customer engagement across all channels, including KPI definition, measurement approach, analytics roadmap, and ongoing performance readouts in partnership with Omnichannel, BU, Data Science, and BI&A teams.
Define clear KPI hierarchies and success metrics that connect channel-level indicators to customer experience and business outcomes.
Generate actionable insights that inform business strategy, drive more data-driven decisions on channel engagement, including engagement funnel, audience prioritization, channel mix, content performance, campaign optimization, and next-best actions.
Perform hands-on analytics where appropriate, while also partnering with vendors and internal Data Science and BI&A teams to deliver high-quality analytics outputs.
Partner with APAC and Japan analytics teams to design test-and-learn approaches, including A/B tests, pilots, benchmarks, and test-and-control methodologies, to improve campaign effectiveness and channel investment decisions.
Translate business objectives to analytical questions to shape and lead the development, deployment, and continuous enhancement of OC dashboards so they become trusted decision tools within weekly and monthly business rhythms, with clear owners, thresholds, interpretation guidance, and next-best action recommendations for OC activation partners and business unit teams.
Support dashboard adoption through documentation, stakeholder training, and executive-level performance storytelling.
 

CDP Ownership & Marketing Automation Advancement

Own CDP operations and capability development for Japan, serving as the JP business lead for CDP reliability, adoption, enhancement, and value realization in close collaboration with APAC, IT, Analytics, Compliance, Omnichannel, and BU stakeholders.
Lead the operational development of CDP capabilities, including segmentation frameworks, identity resolution requirements, trigger logic, data input/output specifications, campaign activation readiness, and measurement enablement.
Shape and influence the CDP roadmap by identifying priority use cases, capability gaps, data requirements, and business value opportunities that support better channel engagement decisions, personalization, and marketing automation.
Serve as the primary bridge between Marketing, Analytics, IT, Omnichannel, and Compliance to ensure CDP capabilities are connected to OC measurement, dashboards, segmentation, activation, and near real-time decision needs, with clear ways of working and decision rights.
Drive marketing automation maturity by implementing best practices in journey orchestration, experimentation, governance, and enablement to expand personalization, improve campaign effectiveness, and increase operational efficiency.
Ensure marketing automation capabilities are measurable, scalable, compliant, and aligned with BU priorities.

Data Quality & Governance 

Collaborate with cross functional teams (IT, compliance, etc.) to ensure data handling aligns with internal policies & external regulations, including consent-related data considerations and compliant activation requirements.
Lead root cause analysis & resolution of data integrity issues, and drive harmonization of KPI definitions, business rules, and data standards across platforms.
Act as subject matter expert on key data sources in customer engagement, digital & performance data.
 

Data Integration Management and Data Pipeline Maintenance & Expansion 

Understand and partner with IT to design & optimize the data pipelines from source systems to marketing activation channels (owned & 3rd party), CDP and dashboards that support real-time data exchange.
Support the extraction of data from various sources.
Ensure data quality and data flows (i.e., metadata, 3rd party data) support omnichannel campaign execution and measurement, being accountable for accurate data interpretation at every stage.
Support strategies for automating data processing, improving data ingestion, cleansing, and accessibility to streamline operations.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in customer experience analytics, omnichannel analytics, digital analytics, marketing analytics, CDP, marketing technology, or related fields.
Strong knowledge of Customer Data Platforms (CDP), including identity resolution, audience/segment management, governance, and activation enablement.
Strong analytical literacy and analytical judgment, with the ability to engage effectively with Data Science, BI&A, and analytics teams; clarify business questions, assess appropriate analytical approaches, interpret outputs, challenge assumptions, and ensure insights are robust, actionable, and linked to business decisions.
Hands-on experience building and iterating dashboards that support decision-making and action tracking (e.g., Tableau) and querying/transforming data (e.g., SQL).
Experience supporting marketing automation and orchestration tools (e.g., SFMC, CRM) including trigger-based engagement, audience deployment, personalization, and campaign measurement.
Experience managing and collaborating with analytics/MarTech vendors (scope definition, requirements, QA, and delivery management) to ensure timely, high-quality insights and dashboard outputs.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills (Marketing, Omnichannel, Analytics, IT, Compliance) with the ability to drive alignment and convert insights into tactical execution.
Strategic, product-minded approach with the ability to define roadmaps (analytics, dashboards, CDP/automation) and deliver continuous improvements / optimization to deliver business impact.
Business-level Japanese & English proficiency.

Preferred Skills & Experiences:

Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS or Google Cloud) and modern data/analytics architectures.
Experience supporting enterprise-scale digital transformation, customer experience, or marketing technology programs.
